message.content:
Washed navy wool-blend blazer, relaxed structured cut, elbow length, #1a233e fabric with a subtle herringbone texture.
Cream merino wool turtleneck sweater, fitted silhouette, long length extending to the waist, #f5f0e6 soft hand-knit fabric.
Tailored charcoal linen-blend trousers, straight leg cut, ankle length, #3b4252 lightweight fabric with a slight drape.
Black leather ankle boots, pointed toe with a 6cm block heel, full shaft height, #1c1c1c smooth calfskin leather.
Silver geometric pendant necklace and matching thin hoop earrings in polished sterling silver, #e8e8e8 metallic finish.
Compact transparent umbrella and a structured taupe clutch bag for potential rain.

This outfit balances the "neat" and "formal" requests with a tailored blazer and refined trousers that elevate casual evening wear without feeling stiff like a full suit. The neutral palette of navy, cream, charcoal, and silver harmonizes with her skin tone while the wool and linen fabrics offer warmth for autumn temperatures. Practical accessories like the umbrella and block-heel boots ensure comfort and mobility if light rain occurs during the date night at the restaurant.
